in_hebrew.name: יואן
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא חנון, ישוע הוא האדון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יואן נגזר מהעברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא חנון' או 'ישוע הוא האדון'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'יוא' שמשמעותו 'אלוהים' ו'ן' שמשמעותו 'חנון' או 'ישוע'. השם יואן מופיע בתנ'ך כ'יוואן' או 'יואן', ומשמש כשם של נביא וגם כשם של כוהן.

in_greek.name: Ιωάν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιωάν προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι χαριστικός' ή 'ο Θεός είναι ευμερής'. Το όνομα αυτό είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος 'יוואן' (Yawan), που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι χαριστικός'. Στο Ευαγγέλιο του Ιωάννη, ο Ιωάν ο Βαπτίστης και ο Ιωάν ο Απόστολος αναφέρονται με αυτό το όνομα.

in_latin.name: Ioan
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ioan significat 'Deus est misericors' vel 'Deus est gratiosus'. Hoc nomen ex hebraeo 'יוואן' (Yawan) derivatur, quod etiam in Novo Testamento invenitur. Ioan Baptista et Ioan Apostolus hoc nomine designantur. Nomen Ioan in Ecclesia Christiana antiquitus usurpatum est.

in_english.name: Ioan
in_english.meaning: God is gracious or God is merciful
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ioan is derived from the Hebrew 'יוואן' (Yawan), which means 'God is gracious' or 'God is merciful'. This name is carried over into the Greek 'Ιωάν' (Ioan) and Latin 'Ioan', maintaining its original meaning. Ioan is a significant name in Christian tradition, associated with John the Baptist and John the Apostle, two prominent figures in the New Testament. The name Ioan symbolizes divine favor and mercy.

St. John the Baptist, known for his role in the announcement and eventual baptism of Jesus Christ, has been venerated as a national saint in various Christian-majority countries, including France, Greece, Malta, Romania, and Portugal. His feast day, the celebration of which marks the beginning of the Advent season, is widely observed in the Western Christian tradition. Additionally, the name is popular in various Eastern Christian traditions, particularly in the Eastern Orthodox Church.
